items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The musicians were Billy Taylor Sr. (bass), Harry Dial (drums), Gene Cedric (clarinet & tenor) and myself.

ctx.x: The musicians were Billy Taylor Sr. (bass), Harry Dial (drums), Gene Cedric (clarinet & tenor) and myself. The recordings got off to a good start and Fats ad-libed on all the singing numbers as though he had been playing and swinging them all his life and he had not seen any of them before they were given to him in the studio. The numbers were chosen by the recording company and not by himself.

Before each number was recorded, Fats would run it down on the piano and then we would go over it a couple of times to set the solos and get the idea about what riff Cedric and I were going to play in certain spots.

Of course drinks were passed around between each number that was recorded and everybody was groovie. We recorded 6 numbers, but when Fats was doing "Night Wind" on the organ, a reed broke on one of the pipes and it took an hour before someone found out which one it was that needed to be repaired. During that time we had a big meal which was paid by the recording company and more drinks.
